summary: Build PD, LGD, EAD, and ECL models with practical IFRS 9 exercises, validation tools, and reporting templates. Enrol today.
lede: Expected Credit Loss (ECL) training covers modelling and measuring impairment under IFRS 9. It is for credit risk, impairment, finance and model governance professionals who need to develop or review loss estimates; participants work on PD, LGD and EAD modelling, test model performance through validation and back-testing, and calculate scenario-weighted ECL using forward-looking macroeconomic scenarios.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work inside credit risk, impairment, finance, or model governance and need to sharpen their IFRS 9 ECL delivery capability.
prerequisites: Recommended prerequisites for this advanced course include working knowledge of credit risk concepts, IFRS 9 impairment terminology, and basic statistics. Familiarity with PD, LGD, EAD, ECL, and portfolio data fields such as arrears, default flags, balances, and cure outcomes will help you participate fully. Prior experience with Excel and at least one analytical environment such as R or Python is useful, although the course can still be followed by experienced credit risk practitioners who mainly need the modelling logic and governance workflow. Coding is not mandatory for completion, but you should be comfortable reading model outputs, parameter tables, and validation summaries. Advanced topics are taught at operational and hands-on implementation level for model design, while regulatory interpretation and governance expectations are covered at application level.
